adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when Zod validation fails (`handleAdd` else-branch), but it is never reset to `false` on a subsequent successful validation/submit attempt. `handleAdd` does not clear it before/after calling `addGuestsMutation.mutate(...)`, and `onSuccess` resets `multiEmailValue`/closes the dialog but also does not clear `isInvalidEmail`. The only explicit reset is in the Cancel button handler, so the error banner can persist after the user fixes emails and retries.
